widget_mechanic: Calendar opens on current month; agent must click the next-month arrow N times to reach target month, then click the target date cell. The default 'do nothing' leaves the calendar at the current month, producing dates near today (wrong).

primary_inspiration.instruction: Book a flight with Wizz Air from Larnaca, Cyprus to Athens, Greece outbound on June 13 returning July 1. If there are no available flights for those dates, please indicate that in your answer.
primary_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Calendar — agent never advanced the month picker to June 2026 to select June 13 as the outbound date.
